node.label: alpha-mannosidosis
node.definition: Alpha-mannosidosis is an inherited lysosomal storage disorder characterized by immune deficiency, facial and skeletal abnormalities, hearing impairment, and intellectual deficit.
synonyms: mannosidosis, alpha-, types I and II

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)

evidence.snippet: Treatment of non-neurological manifestations in patients with mild to moderate alpha-mannosidosis.
1 INDICA TIONS AND USAGE LAMZEDE is indicated for the treatment of non-central nervous system manifestations of alpha-mannosidosis in adult and pediatric patients.
